 In December 1819, S. told Ollier: ‘I mean to write three other poems [similar to J&M], the
scenes of which will be laid at Rome, Florence, and Naples, but the subjects of which will all be
drawn from dreadful or beautiful realities, as that of this was’ (L ii 164); arguably such poems
